definition: Django REST Framework is a core concept in Python Full Stack. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What Django REST Framework is
theory.body: Django REST Framework describes the methods and patterns used within Python Full Stack to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Django REST Framework is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Django REST Framework matters
theory.body: Without Django REST Framework, systems built with Python Full Stack are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Django REST Framework works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Django REST Framework follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Django REST Framework.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Django REST Framework
theory.body: Django REST Framework offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
